data.name: The Last Roll
data.detailed_description:
You're awake? Don't worry, you haven't come down with some "everyone looks like a die" illness. You were accidentally teleported into the world of dice.

The rules here are completely different from those in the human world. Without help, you won't get far.

Far in the north, there is a portal to the human world. I'm your guide, and my job is to get you there. But I won't fight. You'll need to hire other dice to clear the way for you.

I've guided plenty of humans before. You're not the first. To be honest, many never made it to the end. How far you make it depends not only on luck, but even more on your wits!

I Want to Go Home!

Explore, advance, survive combat, claim rewards, and trade dice and cards. Reach the final destination and step into the portal back to the human world.

To Advance or Retreat? That is the Question.

Starting from the beginning of the map, every step forward reveals your next destination. When danger looms, you can instantly teleport back to town to manage your resources and adjust your strategy—but doing so resets your current progress. To press on or to fall back? You must weigh the risks carefully.

Cash or Savings?

All income earned in the wild is carried as cash, which is completely lost upon defeat. Once you enter town, your cash is automatically deposited into savings, protecting it from future failure. If you are carrying a fortune but the road ahead looks treacherous, it might be wise to teleport back to town first. After all, money doesn't come easy...

Look at These Cute Dice!

These colorful dice are your essential companions for moving forward. During combat, roll a chosen die to clear away any obstacles that match its face value. However, if no match is made, you lose that die. Lose all your dice, and your journey comes to an end—so handle them with care!

Cards Matter Too!

Want to retreat, reroll, change a value, or preview the path ahead? That is exactly what cards are for! Keep in mind: if you are defeated, you lose your cards too. Use them when you can—don't hoard them.

data.short_description: An extraction-style board game that demands constant thinking, dice rolling, and decision-making. The true challenge lies not in combat skills, but in tactical choices, resource management, and strategy.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
